metadata.name: Lake Constance Water Quality Data
metadata.description: This dataset contains water quality measurements from Lake Constance, specifically at the Fischbach-Uttwil site. It includes observations of total phosphorus (TP) concentrations averaged for the months of July, August, and September in the upper 20 meters of the water column. The data spans from 1951 to 2010, with each record including the year of observation, depth information, and geographic coordinates.
